title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.
